**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE) — no redline proposed.**

Section 18 already satisfies every element of our *preferred* insurance position:

| Preferred element | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL ≥ USD 1M per occurrence | § 18.1 — "at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence" |
| CGL ≥ USD 2M aggregate | § 18.1 — "USD 2,000,000 aggregate" |
| E&O ≥ USD 2M | § 18.1 — "professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000" |
| Cyber/privacy ≥ USD 5M where Customer Data processed | § 18.1 — USD 5,000,000, granted unconditionally |
| Workers' comp as required by law | § 18.1 — "workers' compensation as required by law" |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 — "On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance" |

Section 18.2 also adds Customer-favourable terms (reputable insurers, primary coverage, notice of cancellation/material reduction, and insurance not limiting Vendor's liabilities), and § 18.1's employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 is cover in excess of our checklist. Nothing here is adverse to us, so we leave the clause as drafted.
